# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

Ran `git diff`, inspected the substrate/process/tracing/engine changes end-to-end, and ran `cargo test -q` plus the targeted root-zone and denitrification test files. The new hook is generally well-covered, but I found one substantive correctness regression: the implementation no longer adds ROL on top of the previous E4a base term because rooted-plant O₂ demand was removed from the base substrate-demand calculation.

## Amendments

1. Restore the rooted-plant O₂ demand term in the E4a base calculation, or otherwise preserve the old E4a baseline before adding the new ROL modifier. In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/substrate.rs:208-238`, `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate()` now excludes rooted biomass entirely, so the new `effective_penetration = base + bonus` path is not actually an additive hook on top of the existing model anymore. A planted bed with `rol_rate_cm_per_g = 0` now collapses to the same substrate-oxygen baseline as an unplanted bed, instead of retaining the preexisting root-respiration O₂ demand. That changes the meaning of the base model and makes the new parameter absorb two effects at once: added root O₂ supply and removed root O₂ consumption.
   Rationale: The bead asked for a modifier on top of the E4a penetration calculation. Deleting root demand from `R_total` changes established behavior and breaks calibratability: users can no longer disable or tune the new hook without also removing rooted-plant substrate respiration from the base redox model.
